reviewTemplate.notes: REQUIRED: identify reviewed unchanged helpers/data/scene branches and actual same-frame evidence; this tool does not determine visual equivalence.

freezeRequirements.instructions: After clips and independent review exist, regenerate --plan-only, then freeze this plan plus every inputSHA256 path. source-sha256.json itself is not an input to the plan, preventing a hash cycle.

limitations: Selected raw take SHA equality is checked; global voice normalization may differ, so old/new full-track PCM equality is not claimed.
The independent review must establish visual equivalence. Metadata equality alone never proves reused scene code is unchanged.
Old mixed audio and all changed-clip audio are discarded. Shared BGM mixing must run after this voice-only output.
